host: vitest jsdom + Node worker (WebAssembly); fixtures rendered by Playwright Chromium at device scale 2, OCR at scale 1

shirtstore-basic.role: DOM + vision, PII in DOM text and fields

visual-fallback.role: one product name/price only on canvas

visual-only.role: all names/prices only on canvas; dark-on-light buttons

visual-privacy.role: PII only on canvas next to non-PII numbers

price-formats.role: 12 prices: rupee sign, Rs, INR, sizes 14 to 32 px, light/gray/dark/green backgrounds

buttons.role: 12 button labels in 8 colour styles and 3 sizes

pii-layouts.role: PII in same-line, form-row and stacked layouts next to 12 non-PII values

pii-collision.role: same digits as OTP and as quantity on one page; expected fail-closed behaviour is measured, not hidden

pii_dom.blocked: Privacy Firewall blocked request: OTP leakage detected

pii_combined.blocked: Privacy Firewall blocked request: OTP leakage detected

detail.combined_block_reason: Privacy Firewall blocked request: OTP leakage detected

boxes.metric: IoU >= 0.5 between ground-truth box and any OCR line box (primary); ground-truth box covered >= 0.9 by one line box (secondary)

pii.note: A firewall block sends nothing: it counts as protected (TP) and the withheld non-PII is reported separately as over-blocking, not as a false positive.

note: Pre-improvement Phase 5 run (single OCR pass, no layout-labelled visual PII). PII box labels replaced by type after the run; no other field changed.
